217 command paths
### -h
exit 0
--- stdout
CLI-first account and session manager

Usage: sessionsation [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  view       Render a Sessionsation-hosted Claude session live (t + Enter takes it over)
  take-over  Stop a hosted Claude worker cleanly, then resume the conversation interactively here
  api        Versioned machine-readable backend contract (JSON/NDJSON)
  setup      Initialize private state and start the metadata-only supervisor
  daemon     
  account    
  status     
  doctor     Report native compatibility; --probe starts only isolated, unauthenticated workers
  run        Start a session with a selected enrolled account (Codex, Claude Code or Gemini CLI); managed switching remains gated
  resume     Resume a saved stable backend ID on its recorded account in this terminal
  shell      Open a plain interactive shell; never re-enter the terminal launcher
  layout     Data-root layout: report it, migrate a legacy (version 1) root to version 2, or roll back. Migrate and rollback need the supervisor stopped
  retention  Retention for logs, cache, operations history and receipts
  shared     Shared Claude conversation state (projects, file-history, todos, session-env) in one store for every account
  root       Root alias and re-key (contract 1.54.0): move the data root and its sessions from one spelling of a bind-mounted tree (/mnt/user/...) to the other (/mnt/disk1/...)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version                    Print version

--- stderr

### --help
exit 0
--- stdout
Account-aware Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI sessions in tmux and HERDR. Use api for the versioned JSON contract.

Usage: sessionsation [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  view       Render a Sessionsation-hosted Claude session live (t + Enter takes it over)
  take-over  Stop a hosted Claude worker cleanly, then resume the conversation interactively here
  api        Versioned machine-readable backend contract (JSON/NDJSON)
  setup      Initialize private state and start the metadata-only supervisor
  daemon     
  account    
  status     
  doctor     Report native compatibility; --probe starts only isolated, unauthenticated workers
  run        Start a session with a selected enrolled account (Codex, Claude Code or Gemini CLI); managed switching remains gated
  resume     Resume a saved stable backend ID on its recorded account in this terminal
  shell      Open a plain interactive shell; never re-enter the terminal launcher
  layout     Data-root layout: report it, migrate a legacy (version 1) root to version 2, or roll back. Migrate and rollback need the supervisor stopped
  retention  Retention for logs, cache, operations history and receipts
  shared     Shared Claude conversation state (projects, file-history, todos, session-env) in one store for every account
  root       Root alias and re-key (contract 1.54.0): move the data root and its sessions from one spelling of a bind-mounted tree (/mnt/user/...) to the other (/mnt/disk1/...)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation

      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting
          
          [possible values: yolo, default]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

### view -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Render a Sessionsation-hosted Claude session live (t + Enter takes it over)

Usage: sessionsation view [OPTIONS] <SESSION>

Arguments:
  <SESSION>  Catalog session id or hosted conversation id

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --once                       Print the current log and exit
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

### api -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Versioned machine-readable backend contract (JSON/NDJSON)

Usage: sessionsation api [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  capabilities        
  placements          Batch host-scoped placement; no per-session host lookup required
  version             Discover the exact executable and contract without contacting a provider
  disk-space          Free space on the data root's filesystem against the `min_free_disk_mb` floor (read-only)
  archives            
  archive             
  restore-session     
  delete-session      
  launch              
  resume-launch       
  account             
  launcher            Return an opaque argv plan for a terminal client to exec
  state               
  session             Resolve public session details against its current catalog generation, or run a session action (`session add-to-herdr ...`)
  attachment          Resolve a current runtime attachment without provider or session discovery
  observe             Bounded read-only native readiness; never sends input or starts a process
  observations        Bounded batch readiness from stdin; optional cached-only reads never contact a provider
  checkpoints         Read public assistant snapshots for an exact turn from a versioned stdin request
  turn-target         Read the latest native turn identity/status; no sending permission required
  steer-target        Resolve the active turn for explicit in-turn steering; never sends input
  recovery-plan       Read a target/host request from stdin and validate an exited-process recovery plan
  recovery-reconcile  Reconcile an interrupted recovery without launching or delivering input
  rename              
  switch              
  auto-start          Per-session Auto Start (1.43.0, revised 1.44.0): start a session after a host boot or a crash; works on stopped sessions too
  auto-recover        Deprecated (1.43.0, use auto-start): per-session auto-recover; --enable is start_prompt
  turn-notify         Per-session turn-end notification (opt-in): journal an event, optionally message a session
  idle-notify         Ask a live Claude session for one native notice when it next goes idle or exits
  usage               Usage windows of every account with age, source and the one meter shape (1.62.0)
  turn-events         Turn-end events of notifying sessions after a cursor; --wait blocks for the next one
  events              Session events of every provider in one shape after a cursor (1.64.0); --wait blocks for the next one, `gap` says when events after the cursor were already dropped
  hooks               Hook health per account and session (1.64.0); `hooks install` installs or repairs them
  relocate            Preview or request a generation-checked directory change or project-folder move
  restart             
  stop                
  resume              
  spaces              Read existing Spaces from this session's own HERDR host, or from the named HERDR server (`--herdr-session`) for a session that is not in HERDR yet
  move-space          Move only the selected terminal into a new tab in an existing Space
  operations          
  respond             
  cancel-operation    
  recover             
  abandon-operation   Operator-only: abandon an uncertain or stuck resume-launch or an uncertain new launch (terminal; sends nothing)
  hosted              Sessionsation-hosted Claude sessions (stream-json worker, viewer, permission prompts)
  answer              Answer an agent's pending question (`pending_questions` in state); answers JSON from --answers or stdin. Idempotent; an attempted answer is never resent
  send                Read a versioned Submit/Queue/Resume/explicit Steer request from stdin
  receipt             
  cancel              
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --api-version <API_VERSION>  [default: 1]
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

  cancel

      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

### api launch -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: sessionsation api launch [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list      List retained receipts without starting or retrying a launch
  validate  Validate a JSON creation request from stdin without creating resources
  start     Admit a JSON creation request exactly once; reconcile using status
  status    
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation

### api account -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: sessionsation api account [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list            
  add             Enroll `codex:<name>` or `claude:<name>`; names are unique across providers
  login           
  logout          Sign out with the provider's own mechanism; refused while the account is in use
  auth            Gemini: show or set the authentication mode. `--mode google` selects Login with Google (Workspace) and returns the login plan; `--mode api-key --key-stdin` reads `{"api_key":"..."}` from stdin, stores it privately and validates it
  reorder         Move an account to a 0-based position in the shared account order
  refresh         Claude: probe `claude auth status` now and update the account auth state
  rename          "Rename only": change just the display name (id, folder and home never change; allowed while sessions run)
  rename-backend  "Rename & update backend": rename the display name, the account folder and the account id (`codex:old` -> `codex:NEW`). Without NEW_NAME the backend is renamed to match the existing display name ("Update backend"). Refused while any session of the account runs; journaled, never replayed
  reset-credit    Codex or Claude: spend one stored rate-limit reset credit (not reversible). Journaled; the request id is the idempotency key, so a retry with the same --request-id can never spend a second credit. Never retried automatically
  managed-home    Claude: switch an adopted account to its managed home (no files are moved)
  restart-server  Codex: restart the account's shared app-server (refused while it serves conversations)
  live-steering   Claude: show, enable or disable live steering (peer messages) for this account. Gemini: show, set or remove experimental.modelSteering (restart sessions to apply)
  bypass-warning  Claude: show, skip or show-again the bypass-permissions (YOLO) startup warning
  enable          
  disable         
  remove          
  delete          
  deletions       
  restore         
  usage           
  limits          Read limits, or explicitly save both used-percentage limits via the owner
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

### api account reset-credit -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Codex or Claude: spend one stored rate-limit reset credit (not reversible). Journaled; the request id is the idempotency key, so a retry with the same --request-id can never spend a second credit. Never retried automatically

Usage: sessionsation api account reset-credit [OPTIONS] [ID]

Arguments:
  [ID]  codex:NAME or claude:NAME (or pass --account)

Options:
      --account <ACCOUNT>          
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --credit-id <CREDIT_ID>      A specific credit to redeem; the backend picks the next one when omitted
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --request-id <REQUEST_ID>    Idempotency key (a UUID); generated when omitted. Reuse it to retry
      --kind <KIND>                Claude: which reset to use when --credit-id is omitted: 5-hour, weekly, fable or full
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

### api session -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Resolve public session details against its current catalog generation, or run a session action (`session add-to-herdr ...`)

Usage: sessionsation api session [OPTIONS]
       sessionsation api session <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add-to-herdr      Open a running session that has no HERDR terminal in a new tab of an existing Space (Claude background sessions via `claude attach`)
  resolve           Resolve `--session` (id, `<space>:<name>` or bare name) to its public row without side effects (1.48.0). `AMBIGUOUS_SESSION` when a name matches several
  set-space         Set (or `--clear`) the stored Space of a session without a live HERDR terminal; catalog only (1.48.0). A live HERDR session moves with `move-space`
  repair-identity   Restore stable session identity (merged ids, continuation lineage) that the identity record holds but the catalog lost, then reconcile. Idempotent; never deletes, recreates or renames an entry
  compact           Queue a compaction for the next idle point: Codex over its app-server, before any held input (1.47.0); Claude by typing /compact into its terminal (1.64.0)
  compact-status    Status of a queued compaction, by operation id or by session (the latest one)
  compact-cancel    Cancel a compaction that has not started; held input is released
  set-model         Change the model (exact id, required) and effort of a running Codex or Claude session at its next idle point, verified from the session itself (1.49.0)
  set-model-status  Status of a model change, by operation id or by session (the latest one)
  set-model-cancel  Cancel a model change that has not started applying
  launch            One pass: start a Codex or Claude session with an exact model and effort, verify both, then deliver the brief; one record keyed by the request id (1.49.0)
  launch-status     Status of a one-pass launch
  help              Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help
          Print help

--- stderr

### api session add-to-herdr -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Open a running session that has no HERDR terminal in a new tab of an existing Space (Claude background sessions via `claude attach`)

Usage: sessionsation api session add-to-herdr [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION> --herdr-session <HERDR_SESSION>

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --herdr-session <HERDR_SESSION>
          HERDR server name
      --herdr-socket <HERDR_SOCKET>
          
      --space <SPACE>
          Existing Space (workspace) id from `api spaces`
      --new-space <NEW_SPACE>
          Label of a Space to create (exclusive with `--space`)
      --create-space
          Create the Space named by a `<space>:<name>` `--name`; refused when it exists (1.48.0)
      --name <NAME>
          Tab name, bare or `<space>:<name>`; defaults to the current session name
  -h, --help
          Print help

### api session compact -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Queue a compaction for the next idle point: Codex over its app-server, before any held input (1.47.0); Claude by typing /compact into its terminal (1.64.0)

Usage: sessionsation api session compact [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION> --when-idle

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --when-idle
          Start only when the thread has no active turn and an empty native queue (required)
      --expires-at <EXPIRES_AT>
          Unix time after which a not yet started compaction expires (default: one hour)
      --operation <OPERATION>
          Idempotency/operation id (a UUID); generated when omitted
  -h, --help
          Print help

### api session set-model -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Change the model (exact id, required) and effort of a running Codex or Claude session at its next idle point, verified from the session itself (1.49.0)

Usage: sessionsation api session set-model [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION> --model <MODEL>

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --model <MODEL>
          Exact model id (e.g. claude-fable-5-2, gpt-6-astra); aliases are refused
      --effort <EFFORT>
          Effort applied after the model; omitted re-applies the effort in force before
      --when-idle
          Wait for an idle point up to --expires-at (default one hour) instead of 60 seconds
      --expires-at <EXPIRES_AT>
          
      --operation <OPERATION>
          Idempotency/operation id (a UUID); generated when omitted
      --wait <WAIT>
          Block until the change ends, at most this many seconds (default 90, 0 with --when-idle; max 600). Not confirmed by then: MODEL_NOT_CONFIRMED with the record
  -h, --help
          Print help

--- stderr

### api session launch -h
exit 0
--- stdout
One pass: start a Codex or Claude session with an exact model and effort, verify both, then deliver the brief; one record keyed by the request id (1.49.0)

Usage: sessionsation api session launch [OPTIONS] --space <SPACE> --name <NAME> --account <ACCOUNT> --model <MODEL> --brief-file <BRIEF_FILE>

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --space <SPACE>
          Existing Space id or label (with --create-space: the label of a new Space)
      --create-space
          
      --name <NAME>
          Session name, bare or <space>:<name>
      --account <ACCOUNT>
          provider:name, e.g. claude:work
      --model <MODEL>
          Exact model id (required): an unspecified start would take the account default, which a Claude /model or /effort in any session of that account changes
      --effort <EFFORT>
          
      --brief-file <BRIEF_FILE>
          The brief (a regular file, or - for stdin)
      --when-ready
          Hold the brief until the model and effort are verified (the default; explicit form)
      --brief-delivery <BRIEF_DELIVERY>
          Claude: `held` (default) or `initial-prompt` (opt-in: handed to Claude at start, before the model can be verified). Codex: `initial-prompt` is accepted and delivered as its `first_turn` (1.61.0) [possible values: held, initial-prompt]
      --directory <DIRECTORY>
          Working directory (default: the current directory)
      --create-directory
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          [possible values: yolo, default]
      --herdr-session <HERDR_SESSION>
          
      --herdr-socket <HERDR_SOCKET>
          
      --request-id <REQUEST_ID>
          
      --deadline <DEADLINE>
          Seconds from admission to a delivered brief (default 300, 30..1800)
      --wait <WAIT>
          Block until complete or failed, at most this many seconds (default 0, max 1800)
      --dry-run
          
  -h, --help
          Print help

--- stderr

### api auto-start -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Per-session Auto Start (1.43.0, revised 1.44.0): start a session after a host boot or a crash; works on stopped sessions too

Usage: sessionsation api auto-start [OPTIONS] --mode <MODE>

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --mode <MODE>
          disabled | start (resume only) | start_prompt (resume, then send the prompt)
      --prompt <PROMPT>
          Prompt for start_prompt (default: a notice naming the restart time)
      --all
          Operator bulk admin: apply to every session (only `--mode disabled`)
  -h, --help
          Print help

--- stderr

### api stop -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: sessionsation api stop [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --keep-pane
          Keep the session's HERDR pane open after it stops (default: close it once the stop is verified)
      --disable-auto-start
          After the stop (or an already-stopped result), also set the session's Auto Start to disabled (1.59.0)
      --wait
          Wait for the stop to finish (1.61.0). Claude and Antigravity stops are already synchronous
      --interrupt
          
      --discard-queued
          Cancel the session's own still-queued input first and list it (1.69.3)
  -h, --help
          Print help

### api move-space -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Move only the selected terminal into a new tab in an existing Space

Usage: sessionsation api move-space [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION> --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION> --request-id <REQUEST_ID>

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --expected-generation <EXPECTED_GENERATION>
          
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --space <SPACE>
          Existing destination Space id (exclusive with `--new-space`)
      --new-space <NEW_SPACE>
          Label of a destination Space to create (exclusive with `--space`)
      --create-space <CREATE_SPACE>
          Label of a destination Space that must not exist yet (1.48.0); unlike `--new-space` an existing label is refused (`WORKSPACE_NAME_EXISTS`). Admission turns it into a checked `new_space`, so journals stay 1.47-readable
      --request-id <REQUEST_ID>
          
  -h, --help
          Print help

--- stderr

### api hosted -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Sessionsation-hosted Claude sessions (stream-json worker, viewer, permission prompts)

Usage: sessionsation api hosted [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  start    Start a hosted worker: a new conversation (--account, --directory) or a stopped one (--session, --expected-generation)
  status   Host record, liveness and pending permission prompts
  stop     Stop the worker cleanly (close input; optionally interrupt the turn first)
  respond  Answer a pending permission prompt
  events   Normalized events (newest last), for clients without a viewer pane
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

### account -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: sessionsation account [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add             Enroll an account. Names are unique across providers
  login           Log in: Codex prints a device code; Claude runs `claude auth login --claudeai` here; Gemini runs `gemini` with NO_BROWSER=true here (choose Login with Google)
  auth            Gemini: show or set the authentication mode. `--mode google` selects Login with Google (Workspace accounts; then run `account login`). `--mode api-key --key-stdin` reads a Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey) from stdin only, stores it in GEMINI_CLI_HOME/secrets/gemini-api-key (0600) and runs one headless validation. Without --mode, shows the mode and whether a key is stored (never the key)
  reorder         Move an account to a 0-based position in the shared account order (list and UI)
  logout          Sign out: Codex app-server account/logout (or `codex logout`), `claude auth logout`, or Gemini's own credential clearing. Refused while the account is in use; log in again afterwards
  rename          Set a display name (the stable name, id and home never change); --clear resets it
  live-steering   Claude: let live sessions of this account accept Sessionsation steering as peer messages (sets `crossSessionInbound: accept` in its settings.json), or stop. Gemini: turn Gemini CLI model steering on or off (sets or removes `experimental.modelSteering` in GEMINI_CLI_HOME/.gemini/settings.json); running sessions keep their value until restarted. Without a flag, shows the current setting
  bypass-warning  Claude: skip or show Claude Code's bypass-permissions (YOLO) startup warning (sets `skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt` in the account's settings.json). Without a flag, shows the current setting
  managed-home    Claude: switch an adopted account to its managed home <root>/accounts/claude/NAME. The directory must already exist (0700, yours, no symlink) and hold the same login; nothing is copied. Refused while Claude is running on either home
  list            List accounts of every provider (table; --json for machine output)
  enable          
  disable         
  show            Read account details, plan, limits and remaining percentages without starting a monitor
  history         Export the same usage/activity bins shown by the account history UI (JSON)
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

### account add -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Enroll an account. Names are unique across providers

Usage: sessionsation account add [OPTIONS] --platform <codex|claude|gemini> <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>             Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --platform <codex|claude|gemini>  Provider for the new account (required; no default) [possible values: codex, claude, gemini, antigravity]
      --config-dir <DIR>                Claude only: adopt an existing CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in place (absolute; never copied or moved)
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>       Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --no-login                        Claude and Gemini: do not start the interactive login after enrolling a fresh managed home
  -h, --help                            Print help

Examples:
  sessionsation account add --platform codex work
  sessionsation account add --platform claude personal
  sessionsation account add --platform claude --config-dir /home/me/.claude existing
  sessionsation account add --platform gemini me
  sessionsation account add --platform antigravity me

### account auth -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Gemini: show or set the authentication mode. `--mode google` selects Login with Google (Workspace accounts; then run `account login`). `--mode api-key --key-stdin` reads a Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey) from stdin only, stores it in GEMINI_CLI_HOME/secrets/gemini-api-key (0600) and runs one headless validation. Without --mode, shows the mode and whether a key is stored (never the key)

Usage: sessionsation account auth [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  NAME or gemini:NAME

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --mode <google|api-key>      
      --key-stdin                  Read the API key from stdin (never pass it as an argument)
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

Examples:
  sessionsation account auth gemini:me
  sessionsation account auth gemini:me --mode api-key --key-stdin < keyfile
  sessionsation account auth gemini:me --mode google

### account history -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Export the same usage/activity bins shown by the account history UI (JSON)

Usage: sessionsation account history [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --range <RANGE>              [possible values: hourly, weekly]
      --hours <HOURS>              
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --start <START>              Inclusive Unix-second range start; requires --end
      --end <END>                  Exclusive Unix-second range end; defaults to the next half-hour boundary
      --step <STEP>                Bin width in seconds, a multiple of 1800; at most 168 bins
  -h, --help                       Print help

      --end <END>                  Exclusive Unix-second range end; defaults to the next half-hour boundary
      --step <STEP>                Bin width in seconds, a multiple of 1800; at most 168 bins
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

Start a session with a selected enrolled account (Codex, Claude Code or Gemini CLI); managed switching remains gated

Usage: sessionsation run [OPTIONS] [-- <CODEX_OPTIONS>...]

Arguments:
  [CODEX_OPTIONS]...  

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --host <HOST>
          Terminal hosting; inline retains the invoking terminal [default: inline] [possible values: inline, herdr]
      --herdr-session <HERDR_SESSION>
          Existing named headless HERDR server (required with --host herdr)
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --account <ACCOUNT>
          
      --thread <THREAD>
          Resume an exact conversation under the selected account
      --session <SESSION>
          
      --hosted
          Claude: run a Sessionsation-hosted (stream-json) session and show its viewer here
      --permission-mode <PERMISSION_MODE>
          With --hosted: account (default) | default | acceptEdits | plan | bypassPermissions
      --name <NAME>
          Name of the new session (same rules as `api launch`); also labels this HERDR tab. Inline host only
  -h, --help
          Print help

### root -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Root alias and re-key (contract 1.54.0): move the data root and its sessions from one spelling of a bind-mounted tree (/mnt/user/...) to the other (/mnt/disk1/...)

Usage: sessionsation root [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  status    Alias, run, per-session states, sessions left behind and the rollback gate (`gate: pass|fail`)
  migrate   Tier R (`--from --to --backup`, supervisor stopped) or Tier S (`--session`, supervisor running)
  rollback  Whole root back to layout version 2 (supervisor stopped), or one session (`--session`)
  finalize  Remove empty old project-key directories (rmdir only). Retained copies are never deleted
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]

      --accounts <ACCOUNTS>
          Comma-separated account order. Pass an empty string to clear
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --current-account <CURRENT_ACCOUNT>
          [default: ""]
      --enable
          Opt in to automatic pause/move/continuation using the manual move worker
      --disable
          
      --accept-experimental
          
  -h, --help
          Print help

### message modes -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Versioned message modes: native Queue and read-only Submit preparation

Usage: sessionsation message modes [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  capabilities  
  request       
  status        
  events        
  cancel        
  sending       Owner-controlled emergency switch; never dispatches a message
  submit-check  Read-only native turn precondition assessment; does not send input
  sessions      Discover existing owner-managed targets; never starts a worker
  target        Read-only managed target state; never starts a worker
  fixture       Run the deterministic isolated fixture from JSON stdin. No native connection
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

--- stdout
Move a live pane or completed inactive thread to another account

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --pane <PANE>                Live tmux pane ID from instances
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --thread <THREAD>            Inactive thread ID from instances
      --to <TO>                    
      --pause                      Approve sending a pause request if the conversation is working
      --accept-risks               Acknowledge history/launch/capacity limitations reported by the move
  -h, --help                       Print help

### sessions -h
exit 0
--- stdout
Read the menu-facing session inventory as JSON (live tmux sessions by default)

Usage: sessionsation sessions [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --include-tmux               Include ordinary and exited tmux panes, without Codex management actions
      --all                        Include deduplicated saved conversations
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
      --watch                      Stream complete snapshots, one JSON object per line, until interrupted
      --interval <INTERVAL>        Poll interval in seconds for --watch [default: 2]
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

      --all                        Include deduplicated saved conversations
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]

### help
exit 0
--- stdout
Account-aware Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI sessions in tmux and HERDR. Use api for the versioned JSON contract.

Usage: sessionsation [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  view       Render a Sessionsation-hosted Claude session live (t + Enter takes it over)
  take-over  Stop a hosted Claude worker cleanly, then resume the conversation interactively here
  api        Versioned machine-readable backend contract (JSON/NDJSON)
  setup      Initialize private state and start the metadata-only supervisor
  daemon     
  account    
  status     
  doctor     Report native compatibility; --probe starts only isolated, unauthenticated workers
  run        Start a session with a selected enrolled account (Codex, Claude Code or Gemini CLI); managed switching remains gated
  resume     Resume a saved stable backend ID on its recorded account in this terminal
  shell      Open a plain interactive shell; never re-enter the terminal launcher
  layout     Data-root layout: report it, migrate a legacy (version 1) root to version 2, or roll back. Migrate and rollback need the supervisor stopped
  retention  Retention for logs, cache, operations history and receipts
  shared     Shared Claude conversation state (projects, file-history, todos, session-env) in one store for every account
  root       Root alias and re-key (contract 1.54.0): move the data root and its sessions from one spelling of a bind-mounted tree (/mnt/user/...) to the other (/mnt/disk1/...)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>
          Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation

      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>
          Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting
          
          [possible values: yolo, default]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

--- stderr

### help api
exit 0
--- stdout
Versioned machine-readable backend contract (JSON/NDJSON)

Usage: sessionsation api [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  capabilities        
  placements          Batch host-scoped placement; no per-session host lookup required
  version             Discover the exact executable and contract without contacting a provider
  disk-space          Free space on the data root's filesystem against the `min_free_disk_mb` floor (read-only)
  archives            
  archive             
  restore-session     
  delete-session      
  launch              
  resume-launch       
  account             
  launcher            Return an opaque argv plan for a terminal client to exec
  state               
  session             Resolve public session details against its current catalog generation, or run a session action (`session add-to-herdr ...`)
  attachment          Resolve a current runtime attachment without provider or session discovery
  observe             Bounded read-only native readiness; never sends input or starts a process
  observations        Bounded batch readiness from stdin; optional cached-only reads never contact a provider
  checkpoints         Read public assistant snapshots for an exact turn from a versioned stdin request
  turn-target         Read the latest native turn identity/status; no sending permission required
  steer-target        Resolve the active turn for explicit in-turn steering; never sends input
  recovery-plan       Read a target/host request from stdin and validate an exited-process recovery plan
  recovery-reconcile  Reconcile an interrupted recovery without launching or delivering input
  rename              
  switch              
  auto-start          Per-session Auto Start (1.43.0, revised 1.44.0): start a session after a host boot or a crash; works on stopped sessions too
  auto-recover        Deprecated (1.43.0, use auto-start): per-session auto-recover; --enable is start_prompt
  turn-notify         Per-session turn-end notification (opt-in): journal an event, optionally message a session
  idle-notify         Ask a live Claude session for one native notice when it next goes idle or exits
  usage               Usage windows of every account with age, source and the one meter shape (1.62.0)
  turn-events         Turn-end events of notifying sessions after a cursor; --wait blocks for the next one
  events              Session events of every provider in one shape after a cursor (1.64.0); --wait blocks for the next one, `gap` says when events after the cursor were already dropped
  hooks               Hook health per account and session (1.64.0); `hooks install` installs or repairs them
  relocate            Preview or request a generation-checked directory change or project-folder move
  restart             
  stop                
  resume              
  spaces              Read existing Spaces from this session's own HERDR host, or from the named HERDR server (`--herdr-session`) for a session that is not in HERDR yet
  move-space          Move only the selected terminal into a new tab in an existing Space
  operations          
  respond             
  cancel-operation    
  recover             
  abandon-operation   Operator-only: abandon an uncertain or stuck resume-launch or an uncertain new launch (terminal; sends nothing)
  hosted              Sessionsation-hosted Claude sessions (stream-json worker, viewer, permission prompts)
  answer              Answer an agent's pending question (`pending_questions` in state); answers JSON from --answers or stdin. Idempotent; an attempted answer is never resent
  send                Read a versioned Submit/Queue/Resume/explicit Steer request from stdin
  receipt             
  cancel              
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --api-version <API_VERSION>  [default: 1]
      --data-dir <DATA_DIR>        Private state directory; defaults to SESSIONSATION_HOME or ~/.local/share/sessionsation
      --permissions <PERMISSIONS>  Permissions for provider processes this command starts: yolo (full access, no prompts) | default (provider prompts); overrides the launch_permissions setting [possible values: yolo, default]
  -h, --help                       Print help

--- stderr

### --version
exit 0

sessionsation 0.2.0
